newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes stay weak, sweet grades attract trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes stay weak, sweet grades attract trade.

text.p: U.S. crudes were sharply lower in aftternoon activity, deflated by huge declines in heating oil futures and nervous pangs about OPEC prodcution intentions, cash traders said.
Selling on the NYMEX eased but the earlier sell-off was fueled by "disappointing gasoil closing in London and rumors Saudi Arabia supported higher OPEC outpout celings," said one trader.
Cash prices marched to the same tune, falling sharply for November West Texas Intermediate/Cushing to $23.25-$23.35 in mid-afternoon, some 75 cts off the Wednesday closings.
